_README: The user-visible controls of /app, as strings that must appear in the built
bundle. ONE file, read by two gates:
- tests/test_web_bundle.py  -> checks web_bundle/ in this repo (commit time)
- scripts/smoke.ps1         -> checks what the DEPLOYED box is serving
WHEN YOU SHIP A USER-VISIBLE CONTROL, ADD A LINE HERE.
That is the whole maintenance burden, and it is why the list is not buried
inside the smoke script where nobody editing App.tsx would ever see it.
A needle should be a string a USER would recognise - a button label, a tab
name, a link target. Not a class name and not an identifier a minifier is
free to rename: the bundle is minified, so only string literals survive.
This list is the readable gate. The unreadable-but-complete one is the
asset-hash check in smoke.ps1: Vite names each asset by its content hash,
so deployed hash == local hash proves the deployed bundle is byte-identical
to this repo's, whether or not anyone remembered to add a line here.
Dates are when the control shipped, so a stale entry is obvious.

controls.what: sign out is reachable from the app
queue explains why a job fits
swipe card explains the two scores
onboarding wizard is in the bundle
CV can be scored from Settings
